findings.message: `evidence_findings(ticket, repo)` in `parse_ticket` exempts a ticket only when its frontmatter `state` is merged or rejected. The engine never restamps frontmatter on merge: historical merged bug tickets such as `tickets/retro-window-bound/ticket.md` and `tickets/mergequeue-snapshot-argv/ticket.md` still say `state: confirmed` and have no `evidence/`. `intake` (tickets.py ~line 691) calls `validate_ticket` before its journal-state guard `states.get(stem) not in {"merged", "already_satisfied", "rejected"}`, so an edit to any such ticket is now refused. That guard is now dead for the missing-evidence case. The Definition of rejected forbids this: "a merged or rejected bug ticket without evidence becomes invalid".
findings.paved_road: Keep the journal-state exemption reachable in intake inside chupa/tickets.py. For example, run the grammar parse without the evidence check for a stem whose journal state is merged, already_satisfied or rejected, and keep `parse_ticket`'s evidence check for every other read. The check must still call `evidence_findings` and add no second copy of the finding text.

findings.message: `test_settled_bug_is_not_rejudged_for_evidence` exists to prove that a historical bug without evidence (its commit message says so) is not rejudged at intake when the journal says merged, already_satisfied or rejected. Adding `evidence_file(root)` to every parametrization makes the test vacuous: it now passes whether or not the exemption works. It hides the regression in the `("confirmed", "merged")`, `("confirmed", "already_satisfied")` and `("confirmed", "rejected")` cases. The ticket says to give a fixture evidence only for tests whose subject is not evidence absence, and to never weaken an assertion.
findings.paved_road: Remove the added `evidence_file(root)` call from this test and fix intake so the journal-settled cases pass without evidence.

findings.message: The updated text says "Settled and rejected tickets are exempt." With this diff that holds only for tickets whose frontmatter state is settled. Intake refuses a journal-settled bug ticket whose frontmatter is still `confirmed`. chupa/docs/host-authoring.md makes the same claim: "Settled and rejected tickets are exempt from the evidence check."
findings.paved_road: Restore the journal-state exemption in intake so the documented exemption is true, and keep both docs accurate.
